name: kettlebell banded swing
description: A kettlebell swing with a band adding tension at the hips. It builds hip drive and posterior chain power.
instructions: Set up with the band around your hips and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Let the kettlebell rise to chest height.
Guide it back between your legs as you hinge.
Keep your back flat and arms relaxed.
